message: The other day, as I was sorting through our storm supplies, I came across an old deck of cards. It reminded me of those long evenings during winter storms when we’d gather around the table, playing games and sharing stories. There’s something comforting about unplugging for a bit, especially when the weather outside is less than friendly. So, I’m thinking maybe we should all rediscover some low-tech fun—who needs a power outage to enjoy a good game of rummy? 🎴
